title: ALU result register never reset -> X propagation to scoreboard
source: VeriSight examples/ (intentional-bug testbed). Ground truth from alu.sv:39-52 comments + alu_spec.md reset requirement.

ground_truth.notes: always_ff reset clause resets carry/zero but omits `result` (alu.sv:43-46), so `result` is X from time 0. Spec requires result=8'h00 on reset.
